digest.component_or_area: outbound Jira DC parent/epic link reconciliation
propositions: test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips fails because it attempts to clear parent on a sub-task, which Data Center rejects with HTTP 400; the Epic Link path is reachable for standard issues and should be used instead
epic_link_field_id can be cleared via {epic_link_field_id: None} on DC 8.17.1 when the parent is managed by rebar (primed through local edit, not created Jira-side)
the cell must prime the parent through a LOCAL rebar edit carried by a real pass so _parent_clear_is_managed and should_propagate_removal recognize it as MANAGED, not unmanaged

test_outbound_set_subtask_parent_round_trips cannot succeed because Data Center refuses sub-task parent writes and no local rebar behavior can reach that path; it should be re-homed under ticket 9f26 to assert bridge alert behavior
set_parent's non-sub-task branch lacks read-back verification unlike the sub-task branch, creating a gap where silent no-ops appear as success

the probe's blocking unknown whether {epic_link_field_id: None} clears is already answered by two existing green cells in live run 30951453979, making the probe unnecessary for unblocking but valuable for regression
